احتربوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَبُوا (iḥtarabū) /iħ.ta.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
# اِحْتَرِبُوا (iḥtaribū) /iħ.ta.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
